assessments.summary: The supplied argument establishes the exact at-most-N-output reduction on an N-point posterior grid by posterior-measure representation and Carathéodory, including the reflection-closed reduction. It completely parametrizes the Q0 hierarchy, verifies the H/L/X witnesses for all audited rows, proves V0(g,k) >= max{F(g),F(k)}, constructs a reflection-invariant three-output receiver attaining c, and derives the stated necessary midpoint window from B(G,K) >= V0(g,k).
scopeQualifications: The result is limited to finite posterior grids and finite-output receivers.
The reflected-class conclusion is proved only for reflection-closed finite grids; no full-functional reflected-optimality assertion is established.
No continuum cardinality theorem, attainment claim, limit interchange, capacity-converse interpretation, or improved sum-capacity bound is established.

The declared reference is needed for the accepted 30-row definitions, optimization order, single-output term structure, and the inequality V_Q(G,K) <= B(G,K); external manuscript authenticity is not required.
